title: Corsair Reports Strong Profit Growth for First Quarter 2026
excerpt: Corsair reported 32.7% Q1 gross margin and USD 35.8 million adjusted EBITDA, guided Q2 to USD 295-320 million revenue and USD 12.5-15.5 million adjusted EBITDA, and left full-year 2026 guidance unchanged at USD 1.33-1.47 billion revenue and USD 100-115 million adjusted EBITDA.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supplies management's segment commentary, Q2 outlook, unchanged full-year revenue, adjusted-EBITDA and non-GAAP EPS ranges, and repurchase context; non-GAAP measures are treated as supplemental rather than substitutes for GAAP results.
